item.title: Daily digest — 2026-07-28
item.description:
It's been an exciting period across our open-source research tools, with multiple projects seeing significant updates. Notably, the `statcheck` and `escicheck` projects have been focusing on synchronization and updates, with `escicheck` syncing changes from the `escicheckapp` repository to bring its `main` branch up to date with `effectcheck` version `0.6.14`. Meanwhile, `oddpub` has improved its ontogenerator's code validation, and `docpluck` has addressed several issues, including text loss and rendering fixes. The `coarse` project has re-enabled Fable 5 in the model picker, and `regcheck` has fixed several bugs, including issues with its demo page, card preview, and ad blocker interference. These updates demonstrate the ongoing collaboration and commitment to improving our research tools, and we celebrate the progress made by our community members.

6 commits across 4 active repositories this week.
